verdict.rationale: Conductor documents an API and a hosted MCP server for managing cloud workspaces, but nothing in the evidence shows issuing scoped or least-privilege API credentials for an agent. The fine-grained GitHub repository access limits Conductor's own access to GitHub, and the API-key-vs-subscription setting covers model-provider keys; both are adjacent controls, not agent credential scoping.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
